description: This file defines React components related to context menu options for notes and categories within a note-taking app. It includes logic for rendering options, dispatching Redux actions, and handling user interactions like renaming, deleting, copying links, and toggling favorites or trash status.

classes.name: ContextMenuOptions
classes.description: Main React functional component that renders specific options based on whether the clicked item is a category or a note.

classes.name: CategoryOptions
classes.description: Component rendering options specific to a category, including renaming and deletion actions.

classes.name: NotesOptions
classes.description: Component rendering options specific to notes, including delete, favorite, trash, download, and copy link functions.

methods.name: _deleteCategory
methods.description: Dispatches action to delete a category by ID.

methods.name: _removeCategoryFromNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to remove a category from notes.

methods.name: _swapFolder
methods.description: Dispatches action to swap the folder view.

methods.name: _setCategoryEdit
methods.description: Dispatches action to set a category in edit mode for renaming.

methods.name: startRenameHandler
methods.description: Handler to initiate renaming of a category.

methods.name: removeCategoryHandler
methods.description: Handler to delete a category and remove it from notes.

methods.name: _deleteNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to delete selected notes.

methods.name: _toggleTrashNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to toggle trash status of a note.

methods.name: _toggleFavoriteNotes
methods.description: Dispatches action to toggle favorite status of a note.

methods.name: _addCategoryToNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to add a category to a note.

methods.name: _updateActiveNote
methods.description: Dispatches action to update the active note.

methods.name: downloadNotesHandler
methods.description: Handler to trigger download of selected notes or a specific note.

methods.name: favoriteNoteHandler
methods.description: Handler to toggle favorite status of a note.

methods.name: trashNoteHandler
methods.description: Handler to move a note to trash.

methods.name: removeCategoryFromNoteHandler
methods.description: Handler to remove a category from a note.

methods.name: copyLinkedNoteMarkdownHandler
methods.description: Handler to copy a note's reference link as Markdown to clipboard.
